concerns.text: Opening claim states the checklist satisfies FR‑001, yet FR‑001 requires ingestion from NIST, UCI, and OpenML repositories. The current tasks only ingest bundled synthetic files, so the claim weakens FR‑001. Even though T014 will later amend FR‑001, the present artifact still violates the requirement.

The residual‑stress proxy formula (`σ_res ≈ k·heat_input·cooling_rate`) is used without any scholarly citation, breaching Constitution Principle II (Verified Accuracy). T013 is intended to add a citation, but until it is completed the artifact is non‑compliant.

Constitution VII mandates that a ≥10 % MAPE improvement be demonstrated **consistently across material classes** and that paired t‑tests be performed per material class. T006 only runs a pooled Wilcoxon test (and mentions a paired t‑test but does not apply it per class), thus the improvement criterion is not verified as required.

Reproducibility (Constitution I) requires all random seeds to be pinned and centrally documented. Seeds are set individually in training (`T005`) and bootstrap (`T009`) scripts, but there is no single, version‑controlled seed‑configuration file, leaving hidden nondeterminism possible.
Same as above: bootstrap mediation (`T009`) sets a seed locally without referencing a global seed definition, risking inconsistency with other stages.
